header: ; H.A.T.E. (Hostile All Terrain Encounter), Vortex Software 1989: the game image $5FB4-$FFFF as the depacker
; leaves it. sjasmplus -I<build> -I<src/game> game.asm gives game.bin, byte for byte the original (tools/build.sh
; packs it into the tape). The resources (INCBIN "res/...") are the files of src/res, listed in src/res/README.md;
; tools/res_formats.py builds the graphics and the tune from their PNG and text sources into build/res.
